Metadata.title: Sound Capsule — your Last.fm sound capsule
Metadata.description: Turn your Last.fm scrobbles into a vertical 1080×1920 card ready to share. No login, no database, and nothing about your profile is stored.
Metadata.ogDescription: Your music recap as a 1080×1920 card ready for stories.

Home.title: Your sound capsule
Home.subtitle: Enter your Last.fm username and pick a time range to build a vertical 1080×1920 summary card ready to share.
Home.usernameHint: Paste your profile link or type your username. The profile must be public and have scrobbles in the selected period.

custom.warning: Longer ranges fetch more pages and may take a few extra seconds.

Home.privacy: No login · No database · Only language and theme are saved in this browser

preview.title: Preview (9:16)
preview.emptyHint: Fill in the username and time range to generate it.

actions.shareFallback: Sharing is unavailable. The PNG was downloaded instead.
actions.exportError: Could not render the PNG. Please try again.

estimate.label: Estimated time (≈)
estimate.tooltip: Last.fm does not report total listening time. We query track.getInfo for your ~50 most played tracks and use 3.5 min for the rest or for tracks without a duration. The number shown is an approximation.
